facility.name: Building Blocks Academy-Evergreen

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked: The lock on the outside gate was broken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked (26 TAC §746.4309)

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: There is sufficient evidence to support that children are not being sign in and out of the operation
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: An infant was seen sleeping in a restrictive device. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver moved the child to a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the information received during the investigation. The caregivers had their backs during the incident and did not see the victim run back to the window. Also while attending to the injuries of the child, the caregivers were not giving adequate supervision to the other children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The tiles on the floor are being held by duct tape.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area: There is sufficient evidence to support that there are no handwashing sinks in two classrooms with diaper changing stations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area (26 TAC §746.4403(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two out of ten children's files were missing emergency contact addresses, but this was corrected when the director got on the phone with the parents to update the information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Out of the 10 employee files evaluated, one file was missing training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: There was an infant four months old wearing a bib in the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A 16 month old infant was observed having screen time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: A see saw was observed on the playground without surfacing.     Note: A photo was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The boys school age restrooom was observed with water on the floor and a unflushable toilet.    Note: A picture was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A three year old child was found unsupervised in a hallway with no caregiver present to provide appropriate supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: Three caregivers did not know and did not have access to information to know the ages of the children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The floor of the bridge between buildings had a caved in area with cracked flooring and soft subflooring. Upon reinspection, the floor had not been repaired. The crack had worsened, and other areas of flooring on the bridge had begun to crack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A 10 month old infant was observed sleeping with a bib around his neck and near his face.    This was corrected when a caregiver removed the bib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area: Four diaper changing areas still did not have sinks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3503(d))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: A sippy cup was observed in an infants bed.    This was corrected when the caregiver removed the cup.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Two infants were observed at the large feeding table without straps fastened.    This was corrected when the caregiver fastened both children in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The floor of the bridge between buildings had a caved in area with cracked flooring and soft subflooring.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: Both infant sinks were being used for handwashing and dishes/bottles.    This was corrected when a conversation was had with the director and caregivers about designating one sink for handwashing only.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: A four month old infant was observed in a restrictive device for one period of approximately 18 minutes, and another period of approximately 24 minutes.     This was corrected when the infant was removed and a conversation was had with the director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: A ten month old and four month old infant were observed sleeping on ill fitting sheets that were loose enough to present a suffocation hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: An infant was observed walking around the classroom with a bottle of formula.    This was corrected when a conversation was had with the director about removing the bottle and not allowing any other children to walk around with bottles or sippy cups.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: There was sufficient evidence to suggest that caregivers are using their personal phones while supervising the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Holding and Comforting: There was sufficient evidence to suggest that infants are being left to cry in their cribs when they are upset.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Holding and Comforting (26 TAC §746.2401(3))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: One of the diaper changing pads had cracks, exposing the absorbant material underneath.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3503(d))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area: Four diaper changing areas did not have sinks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3503(d))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Three out of Six Employees did not have the required annual health and safety training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The fire extinguishers had not been checked for July.     This was corrected when the director checked them and recorded it on the emergency practices page.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The operation had not performed fire extinguisher checks this year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two of ten children's files did not have addresses for emergency contacts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Two of ten children's files did not have complete emergency authorization information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
